title: Handoff note on recycle at the WCLI-14 / WCLI-46 boundary
description:
Written at the renewal boundary on 2026-09-29, when the orchestrator recycled this session on the fleet context budget. Every ref, commit and status below was read back from live state rather than remembered; where a claim rests on a measurement, the command or file that produced it is named.

WHAT THIS SESSION LANDED, in order, all on dev and all through gated pull requests:
- opum-ai/ward-cli#116, de3439b - WCLI-57, one SHA runs one CI run. The pull_request trigger is scoped to base branch dev, which is the option that removes the duplicate at its source rather than cancelling it. Proven live in both directions: a control PR opened before the change produced the duplicate run in 10 s, its twin after the change produced none in 80 s, and both later landings produced exactly one run each.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#118, 942315c - WCLI-14's block half: ward agents --check and --update-instructions for claude and codex over the managed block, plus a test pinning plugin.json's version to package.json's, with the mutation proof that the contract test which now covers the command can still go red.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#119, c4dcc33 - WCLI-59: the vault-store case that corrupts a ciphertext now corrupts by construction, and the raw helper refuses a mutation that changed nothing. The task was filed on a bun:sqlite lost-write that does not exist; the correction is in that record with how it got in.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#120, 3173af7 - WCLI-46: every test temporary root is removed in its own file's teardown, so a killed run no longer leaves 122 MB behind. Measured: a full run now leaves every temp-root family unchanged.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#121, 9c54c5c - DEC-44 and DEC-45 recorded as ADR 0011, ADR 0012 and docs/runbooks/release-smoke-t24-manual-half, with two spec clauses corrected in place, and the new concepts declared in the specialist profiles that must reach them.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#122, 598fd5e - WCLI-34: a check that fails, naming file and line, on a binding named declare, which Bun 1.3.14 strips silently along with its calls.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#123, 303c910 - WCLI-19 verified complete with no code: the decision it waited for says accept the variables as a stated P0 limitation, and both live criteria were already satisfied by work that landed with WCLI-3.
- opum-ai/ward-cli#124, a7ff1c2 - WCLI-34's close, which the first pass had missed: the work landed and the completion never ran.

PARKED ON THE OPERATOR, and nothing else is: DEC-46, DEC-47 and DEC-48 for WCLI-14 (the stored selection, the leftover local skill file, and the multiselect's interaction shape) and DEC-49 for WCLI-46 (whether the harness sweeps stale temp roots itself or an explicit command does). Two A/B packets were sent to opum-agent for filing: WCLI-38 (does profileSnapshotVersion bump at the first release) and WCLI-30's second criterion (does WARD_MVP_AGENT_SPEC.md become a bundle concept a profile can cite, as a pointer concept rather than an extract). Neither was decided here. WCLI-14 and WCLI-46 both stay In Progress with nothing falsely checked, and each carries its own handoff note.

THREE CORRECTIONS THIS SESSION MADE, recorded rather than quietly applied, because each one is a shape a successor can repeat: the bun:sqlite lost write was this session's own probe counting a 1-in-256 randomblob collision as a failure (WCLI-59); the note that had component design as the repository's own call is superseded by the operator's 2026-09-29 design-authority ruling, so design questions go to the operator through opum-agent; and a grep pattern BSD grep cannot match produced a false absence that was one step from being filed as a finding (WCLI-19's record).

WHAT THE SUCCESSOR SHOULD REACH FOR: the opum-sdlc skill before any branch or pull request, the opum-handoff skill in restore mode at start, and quest and lore for the tracker and the docs bundle. The repository's own gates are bun run check (which now includes the reserved-binding check), lore check --strict and lore validate --strict.
finalSummary:
The session handoff for the 2026-09-29 recycle, delivered as a record rather than as code: the description above carries what landed, what is parked on whom, the three corrections this session made, and what a successor should reach for first.

One path in the description is wrong and is corrected here rather than left to mislead: the T24 runbook is docs/runbooks/release-smoke-t24-s-manual-half.md - it is about T24's manual half, not a "t24-manual" runbook.

State at the boundary, read back rather than remembered: eight commits on dev (de3439b, 942315c, c4dcc33, 3173af7, 9c54c5c, 598fd5e, 303c910, a7ff1c2), no open pull requests, a clean tree, WCLI-14 and WCLI-46 the only tasks In Progress and both carrying their own handoff notes and parked on DEC-46 through DEC-49. WCLI-57, WCLI-59, WCLI-19 and WCLI-34 are closed.
